S.FORM: alang Kalahaay ga niya mki sku Tayto Keng atu Cinkong Song, kwara sali buwan nya ga 738 buwan, 2,154 hi ku kwara s'uli tayan. s'uli tayan pinspngan Gyencumin ga 15% kyan ku 316 hi, binah ga, 'yat kahun sku pinspngan Gyencumin ga 85% kyan ku 1,838 hi nya. pinspung na linhuyan Gyencumin ga, Amis 13%, Paywan 0.4%, Puyuma 0.4%, binah lihuyan s'uli 0.5%. rhzyal kki'an tay mkraya' na Kalahaay hya' ga Cirarokohay. tay 'zil na Kalahaay hya' ga Madawdaw. rekisi kayal kyokay qalang Kalahaay ga ungat kyokay. ssquliq pinlpgan ppqbaqan pqwasan biru 'laqi' cikuy maki 1 pqwasan biru 'laqi' cikuy. pqwasan biru 'laqi' mrkyas maki 1 pqwasan biru 'laqi' mrkyas. tuqi 'san basu kisya' glgan spyangan na pinbahu Ubuy qqmayh
S.PHON: alaŋ kalaħaaj ɣa nija mki [s|ɕ]ku tajto keŋ atu [ʦ|ʨ]inkoŋ [s|ɕ]oŋ kwara [s|ɕ]ali βuwan nja ɣa *** βuwan **** ħi ku kwara [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku *** ħi βinaħ ɣa ʔjat kaħun [s|ɕ]ku pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku **** ħi nja pin[s|ɕ]puŋ na linħujan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ami[s|ɕ] ** pajwan ** pujuma ** βinaħ liħujan [s|ɕ]ʔuli ** rħzjal kkiʔan taj mkrajaʔ na kalaħaaj ħjaʔ ɣa [ʦ|ʨ]irarokoħaj taj ʔzil na kalaħaaj ħjaʔ ɣa ma*aw*aw reki[s|ɕ]i kajal kjokaj qalaŋ kalaħaaj ɣa uŋat kjokaj [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]quliq pinlpɣan ppqβaqan pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ [ʦ|ʨ]ikuj maki * pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ [ʦ|ʨ]ikuj pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ mrkja[s|ɕ] maki * pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ mrkja[s|ɕ] tuqi ʔ[s|ɕ]an βa[s|ɕ]u ki[s|ɕ]jaʔ ɣlɣan [s|ɕ]pjaŋan na pinβaħu uβuj qqmajħ
